cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/maxgen.py <<'PY'
import json,random,sys,collections
rnd=random.Random(2)
streams=[]
for si in range(8):
 full=si<7; n=256
 nl=512 if full else 392
 ext=16 if full else 8
 def nm(i):return 'N%03d'%i
 nodes=[{'id':i,'name':nm(i),'external_capacity':rnd.choice([1,10,1000000000])} for i in range(n)]
 links=[];seen=set();deg=[0]*n
 for i in range(n):
  a=i;b=(i+1)%n;e=(min(a,b),max(a,b));seen.add(e);links.append((a,b,rnd.randint(0,10**9)));deg[a]+=1;deg[b]+=1
 while len(links)<nl:
  a=rnd.randrange(n);b=rnd.randrange(n)
  if a==b:continue
  e=(min(a,b),max(a,b))
  if e in seen or deg[a]>=8 or deg[b]>=8:continue
  seen.add(e);links.append((a,b,rnd.randint(0,10**9)));deg[a]+=1;deg[b]+=1
 adj=[[] for _ in range(n)]
 for a,b,c in links:adj[a].append(b);adj[b].append(a)
 extids=list(range(ext))
 demands=[[a,b,10**9] for a in extids for b in extids if a!=b]
 # BFS path for each ordered pair
 paths={}
 for s in extids:
  paths[nm(s)]={}
  for d in extids:
   if s==d:continue
   prev={s:None};q=collections.deque([s])
   while q:
    x=q.popleft()
    if x==d:break
    for y in adj[x]:
     if y not in prev:prev[y]=x;q.append(y)
   p=[];x=d
   while x is not None:p.append(x);x=prev[x]
   p=p[::-1]
   paths[nm(s)][nm(d)]=[{'path':[nm(x) for x in p],'weight':1000}]
 topo={'nodes':nodes,'links':[{'source':a,'target':b,'capacity':c} for a,b,c in links],
       'external_nodes':[nm(i) for i in extids]}
 S={'trials':32,'epsilon':250000,'seed':rnd.randrange(2**32),'cutoff':[0,1],'bias':0,'tau':0,'gamma':[1,1],'cache_slots':8}
 ev=[{'op':'patch','demands':demands,'counters':{}},{'op':'routes','label':'r','paths':paths},{'op':'repair','id':'repair'}]
 for j in range(4):ev.append({'op':'validate','id':'repair'})
 streams.append({'topology':topo,'settings':S,'events':ev})
json.dump({'streams':streams},sys.stdout,separators=(',',':'))
PY
